name: Boundless Fury raises Pestilence of Death's unleash effectiveness by 30% (#1262)
contract: Boundless Fury 704954 reads 'Increases the effectiveness of the unleash effect from Pestilence of Death by 30%' (bindmysoul.com/conquest/talents.normalized.json, fetchedAt 2026-07-22T23:10:31.369Z; matches the client's own moa_description). Its own baked effect is a native aura 108 (SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER) SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS classmask (dword0 bit26, matching Unleash Death 801055 specifically) duplicated identically on two effect slots, but AscensionXoroth.cpp's Unleash() drives the unleash spells' damage entirely through the custom State(player).unleash multiplier (read in ModifySpellEffectBaseValue), which never consults that spellmod bucket. AscensionXorothContracts.cpp nulls both duplicate effects; Unleash() now multiplies its strength parameter by (1 + Amount(704954)/100) - i.e. 1.3x - specifically when the active unleash is Pestilence of Death's (spell == 801055) and the caster has aura 704954.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: Pestilence of Death is active
Unleash Death's damage without the talent
SETUP: the untalented unleash actually hit the target
Force the Boundless Fury passive aura
SETUP: the Boundless Fury passive is active
Let the second Unleash Death hit resolve
CONTRACT: the second unleash deals ~30% more damage than the first
